headings.rules: NEVER use Inter for headings. Use these condensed, heavy fonts to evoke athletic performance.

body.rules: Use for all data tables, inputs, and dense information.

typography.hierarchy_gap_rule: The jump between a heading and its subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps. H1 max text-5xl.
typography.typesetting: Tight line height (leading-none) for headers. Overlines/labels must be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

backgrounds.rules: Tinted grey rule: Never use pure #000000. zinc-950 provides a deep, tactical athletic feel.

layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
layouts.bento_rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children to stretch to match neighbors. No jagged bottoms.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.global_style: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style layout. Items have subtle borders (border-border/40). NO soft shadows.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color brightens (border-lime-400/50).
surfaces_and_micro_themes.headers: Solid Background with a hard bottom border. Never use fully transparent header over hero images.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.forms: Complex tournament setups need flat solid surfaces. Glassmorphism is FORBIDDEN for the scheduling/conflict data to prevent visual refraction of data.

components.buttons: Sharp, tactical. rounded-none or rounded-sm. Primary buttons use bg-lime-400 text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider.
components.tables: Shadcn table components. Dense styling. Header rows text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-500.
components.forms_inputs: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Form, Checkbox heavily customized in .js format. Never native inputs. Focus states MUST have higher contrast: focus:border-lime-400 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-lime-400.
components.brackets_knockouts: Custom flex/grid based layouts for bracket trees with crisp 1px solid lines (border-zinc-700) connecting nodes. Winner nodes highlighted with lime-400 text.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain/noise overlay to kill digital flatness on main wrapper backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.lines: 1px solid strokes to separate all zones. Tactical Minimalism.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use the provided heavily-darkened stadium/pitch images as a backdrop for 'No tournaments found' or 'No matches scheduled'.

motion.rules: Minimalist micro-interactions for feedback. Entrance animations staggered for lists (framer-motion).
motion.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-lime-400).

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. When placing text over images, use bg-black/60 overlay minimum.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must be visible. focus:ring-1 focus:ring-lime-400 focus:outline-none.
accessibility.data_testid: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

hero_stadium.description: Football stadium at night with lights on. Must be used with heavy overlay (e.g., bg-zinc-950/80) so it's barely visible, providing texture without distraction.

pitch_texture.description: Bird's-eye view of a green soccer field. Use in 'Create Tournament' empty states with grayscale filter.

referee_silhouette.description: Silhouette of soccer figures. Use for Referee/Coach empty states.

media.rules: Preserve main subjects. Never use placeholder images. All background images must have an overlay of at least bg-black/50.

icons.instructions: Standard installation. Use crisp, geometric icons. Avoid overly playful/rounded icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST use Tailwind CSS and raw HTML (div, span) for structure, and Shadcn/UI for logic components (Select, Dialog, Tabs).
TournamentOS is a data-heavy SaaS. Use the High Density Grid (Mode B) from bento guidelines.
Smart scheduling conflict warnings must be highly visible (e.g., bg-red-500/10 border-red-500).
Design the Knockout Bracket visually using flex/grid structures, not tables.
Install and use 'sonner' for toast notifications (import from src/components/ui/sonner.js).
All components are .js files, NOT .tsx. Generate and customize Shadcn components in JS.
Avoid the 'Default Vercel' look. Apply the 'Grid Borders' tactical look.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components.
Ensure all Grid children are direct descendants.
Include 'data-testid' on every form submission, tab, dialog trigger, and card action.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
All components are in .js formats. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx).
